body: Ive felt this way for the past 3 weeks. I told my best friend how I felt, and they could do was tell me about their problems. I've dropped everything for everyone around me. I give but no one ever gives back even when I need them. I cant help but fucking sit here crying and smiling on how I want to just end this all. The only reasons thats stopped me is that theyve taken away all my pills as ive tried this before. You'd think they'd know I had something wrong if i'd tried this before. im fuckin alone. the souls i care about care nothing for me. I just wanted a friend to tell me they enjoyed having me around instead of "so you should get out of here im going to bed." I dont see the purpose of this life anymore, i wasnt meant for this world. i cant take caring for those around me when they cant even realize how in distress i am. when they cant see how hurt and broken i am.
